title: queue backend
description: The marker .queue/backend: the backend every writer of a served folder takes turns with. Without it the backend is files. It never holds an address or a token; those come from the app's settings. apiVersion and kind never change; spec may grow.

type.description: files: the file queue in the folder; lock-service: a separate service takes the turns. An app refuses a type it does not run.

spec.description: Open: a newer app may add fields here, and an older reader accepts them (CT-RULE-4); never an address or a token.
